lines.japanese: 「ん、っと……この辺だよな……」
lines.english: “Let's see... Should be around here...”

lines.japanese: ハリュー・クロードから受けとった地図は、なかなかに大雑把だった。目の前にある個人商店っぽい名前の商店だけが頼りになる。
lines.english: The map Claude Haryuu had given me was pretty damn vague. All I had to go on was the shop in front of me, with a name that sounded like a mom-and-pop place.

lines.japanese: 「おっ、ここか」
lines.english: “Oh. This it?”

lines.japanese: 町田商店の前の建物……趣味の悪い郵便受けが目印……うん、間違いはなさそうだ。
lines.english: The building in front of Machida Shop... Look for the ugly mailbox... Yeah, this had to be the place.

lines.japanese: 地図の下に書いてある住所も確認したけど間違いない。住宅ではなく、アットホーム企業の事務所ってカンジだ。前面にガレージ車庫のシャッターが下りている。
lines.english: I checked the address written at the bottom of the map too. No mistake. It didn't look like a home so much as the office of some cozy little family business. A garage shutter covered the entire front.

lines.japanese: 近付くにつれ、絵の具の臭いが強くなる。耳をそばだてると、うっすら鳳の声が聞こえた。
lines.english: The closer I came, the stronger the smell of paint grew. When I listened carefully, I could faintly hear Kakeru's voice.

lines.japanese: 会話してる、ってことは誰か他にいるのか。
lines.english: If he was talking, somebody else must be in there.

lines.japanese: まあいい。とりあえず中へ入れてもらおう
lines.english: Whatever. First I'd get him to let me in.

lines.japanese: 「鳳ー。俺だ、邪魔すんぞー」
lines.english: “Kakeru! It's me. Coming in.”
“Huh?”
“What?”
“Oh.”

lines.japanese: ガレージの向こうには、鳳翔……とその妹がいた。
lines.english: On the other side of the garage were Kakeru Ohtori... and his sister.

lines.japanese: 兄妹の前には、身長ほどの巨大なボードが立てかけられている。ふたりとも汚れた作業エプロン姿だった。
lines.english: A huge board as tall as they were stood propped in front of them. Both wore stained work aprons.

lines.japanese: 俺たちは一瞬硬直した。
lines.english: For an instant, all three of us froze.

lines.japanese: いや、もちろん、兄と妹がふたり仲良くお絵描きしてたからって何も驚く要素はない。
lines.english: Naturally, there was nothing surprising about a brother and sister happily painting together.

lines.japanese: しかし当人たちがあまりに“見られたくないところを見られた顔”で言葉を失っているので、ついこちらも“見てはいけないものを見てしまってすみません顔”になってしまった。
lines.english: But they both looked so much like they'd been caught doing something they desperately wanted hidden that I reflexively put on the face of a man apologizing for seeing what he wasn't supposed to see.

lines.japanese: このふたりはなぜか、周囲から兄妹仲が良いと思われることを嫌うのだった。
lines.english: For some reason, these two hated anyone thinking they got along as siblings.

lines.japanese: 「お、おう、悪いな突然。鳴もいたんだ」
lines.english: “Uh, hey. Sorry to show up out of nowhere. Didn't know you were here too, Naru.”

lines.japanese: 無断で訪問してしまった負い目もあるので、とりあえず自分から沈黙を破った。
lines.english: I already felt guilty for dropping by uninvited, so I broke the silence myself.

lines.japanese: 「や、やー、こんばんはー隼人さん。えー、ふしぎー、こんなところで会うなんて奇遇ですねー」
lines.english: “O-oh, good evening, Hayato. Wow, how strange. Imagine running into you in a place like this. What a coincidence.”

lines.japanese: 「隼人さん、こちらにはよくいらっしゃるんですか？　私は今日が初めてなんですけどー、ええ、たまたま。たまたま兄に手伝ってくれと言われて、本当は家でクラシックを嗜む予定だったんですけど仕方なく」
lines.english: “Do you come here often, Hayato? This is my first time. Pure coincidence, of course. My brother happened to ask me for help. I had planned to spend the evening appreciating classical music at home, but alas.”

lines.japanese: 「えー、おまえ家でゲームしてただけじゃん」
lines.english: “What? You were just playing video games at home.”

lines.japanese: 「うるさい。ちょっと黙ってて」
lines.english: “Quiet. Stop talking for a second.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、ほんと、突然すいません……」
lines.english: “Seriously, I'm sorry I showed up...”

lines.japanese: いたたまれなくなって謝るしかない。
lines.english: The awkwardness became so unbearable that all I could do was apologize.

lines.japanese: 「なんだよ隼人、来るなッつったのに。コレ納期あしたなんだよ」
lines.english: “What the hell, Hayato? I told you not to come. This is due tomorrow.”

lines.japanese: ああ、忙しいのは本当だったのか。
lines.english: Oh. So he really had been busy.

lines.japanese: 「えー、でも締め切りなんて、あってないようなものだって言ってたじゃんー」
lines.english: “But you said deadlines barely count as real.”

lines.japanese: 「うるせえよ。ちょっと黙ってろ」
lines.english: “Shut up. Stop talking.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、ほんと、突然すいません……」
lines.english: “Seriously, I'm sorry I showed up...”

lines.japanese: なんかもう帰りたくなってきた。
lines.english: I was starting to want to go home.

lines.japanese: しかし、ここまで来てそういうわけにもいかない。
lines.english: But I couldn't turn around after coming this far.

lines.japanese: 「鳳、ちょっといい」
lines.english: “Ohtori, got a minute?”

lines.japanese: 兄貴の方に、外で話がしたいと身振りで示した。
lines.english: I gestured to the brother that I wanted to speak outside.

lines.japanese: 「まあ、なんですかしら？」
lines.english: “Why, whatever could it be?”

lines.japanese: だが返事をしたのは妹の方だった。
lines.english: But it was the sister who answered.

lines.japanese: 「いや、妹の方じゃなくて」
lines.english: “I meant your brother.”

lines.japanese: 「えー、どうしてですかー、私は用なしですかー。ラ・フランスー」
lines.english: “Oh, why? Am I not needed? Just a spare? A pear? La France!”

lines.japanese: 「いいだろよ、おまえとは昨日も一昨日も会ってんじゃねーか」
lines.english: “You'll live. I saw you yesterday and the day before.”

lines.japanese: 「へえー。連日連夜ねえ」
lines.english: “Really? Night after night, huh?”

lines.japanese: 鳳（兄）は嫌味とも冷やかしとも取れる微妙な野次を入れた。
lines.english: Kakeru offered a remark that could have been either sarcasm or teasing.

lines.japanese: 「ち、ちげーよ。たまたまいろいろな用事が重なっただけだっつうの」
lines.english: “Th-that's not it. A bunch of unrelated stuff happened to fall on those days.”

lines.japanese: 「えー、なんでそんな照れ隠しみたいなこと言うんですか、ふつーにデートじゃないですかー」
lines.english: “Why are you making it sound like you're hiding your embarrassment? They were perfectly ordinary dates.”

lines.japanese: 「ばっ……ちょ、黙ってろって。肉親の前でそーゆー話するときは、四割減ぐらいで言っとくモンなんだよ」
lines.english: “Idiot... Shut up. When you talk about that stuff in front of family, you're supposed to play it down by forty percent.”

lines.japanese: 「隼人ー。表出ろよ」
lines.english: “Hayato. Step outside.”

lines.japanese: 「いやいや、ちょっと待てって。会ってるけど、頻繁には会ってるけど、一応ちゃんとマジメに付きあってるんだって。全然そんな、いい加減な気持ちとかじゃ──」
lines.english: “No, no, wait. We are seeing each other, and pretty often, but we're dating seriously. I don't feel casual about her at all—”

lines.japanese: 「は？　なに言ってんのおまえ。べつにこのガキが、どこのクソ男に泣かされようと知ったこっちゃねえよ」
lines.english: “Huh? What are you talking about? I couldn't care less which piece of shit makes this brat cry.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃなくて、おまえ俺に話があって来たンだろ？　タバコ吸いたいから外に出ようって言ってんの」
lines.english: “I meant you came here to talk to me, right? I want a cigarette, so let's go outside.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、あァ、そうか。よし、出よう出よう」
lines.english: “O-oh. Right. Yeah, let's go.”

lines.japanese: にわかにこっ恥ずかしくなった俺は、慌ててガレージを出た。
lines.english: Suddenly mortified, I hurried out of the garage.

lines.japanese: 「るー、ちょっと石膏用意しといて」
lines.english: “Ruu, get the plaster ready.”

lines.japanese: 「ええー？　なにそれ、私かーくんのパシリじゃないんだけどー！」
lines.english: “What? Why me? I'm not your errand girl!”

lines.japanese: 鳳は俺の話がキナ臭いものだと直感しているようだ。妹が立ちいってこないよう、理由を作ってガレージに縛りつけていた。
lines.english: Kakeru seemed to have sensed that my business smelled dangerous. He had invented a reason to keep his sister in the garage and out of it.

lines.japanese: こういった空気に鼻が利くあたりはさすが元・不良帝国の皇帝陛下だ。もっとも今じゃどこにでもいるアットホームな兄妹──
lines.english: His nose for that kind of trouble befitted the former Emperor of a delinquent empire. Though now he and his sister looked like any warm, close-knit family—

lines.japanese: 「おいクソ妹、石膏用意しとけボケ」
lines.english: “Hey, shitty little sister! Get the plaster ready, dumbass!”

lines.japanese: 「んもう、いやですわ。わたくしお兄様のヘルパーさんじゃなくってよ」
lines.english: “Goodness, no. I am not my dear brother's little helper.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、そんな、わざわざやり直さなくても……」
lines.english: “You really don't have to redo the whole performance...”

lines.japanese: ──アットホームな兄妹は見られたくない一面だったようだ。
lines.english: —apparently, being seen as a warm, close-knit family was another side they wanted hidden.

lines.japanese: 「で、なに、話って」
lines.english: “So, what did you wanna talk about?”

lines.japanese: 「話っていうか、まあ、頼みなんだけど」
lines.english: “It's more of a favor.”

lines.japanese: 俺は鳳の前に鞄を差しだした。
lines.english: I held out the bag in front of him.

lines.japanese: 「なにそれ。海外旅行でもすんの」
lines.english: “What's that? Going overseas?”

lines.japanese: 「下手したら高飛びって形で。ちょーちょー」
lines.english: “If this goes badly, I might have to flee the country. Hey, look.”

lines.japanese: バッグに顔を近付けるよう促す。
lines.english: I motioned for him to bring his face closer to the bag.

lines.japanese: 「誰にも言うなよ。実はこれ……」
lines.english: “Don't tell anybody. The truth is, this...”

lines.japanese: 「わオ。すーっげ、粉モノじゃん。きめえ」
lines.english: “Wow. That's a shitload of powder. Gross.”

lines.japanese: 鳴に聞こえることを気にしたわけじゃないだろうが、鳳はドレッドほどの驚き方を見せなかった。
lines.english: I doubted it was because he was worried Naru would hear, but Kakeru didn't react anywhere near as loudly as the dreadlocked guy had.

lines.japanese: 「なに、隼人はそっち系に就職決めたんだ？」
lines.english: “What, Hayato? Decide on a career in that business?”

lines.japanese: 「馬鹿、ちげえよ。そんなもん、誰がなるか」
lines.english: “Idiot. No. Who the hell would?”

lines.japanese: 「あははは、だよねえ。俺、いくら妹に興味ないって言っても、流石にヤーさんのとこへは嫁行ってほしくないわ。血縁になると色々面倒だし」
lines.english: “Hahaha, right. No matter how little I care about my sister, even I wouldn't want her marrying into the yakuza. Being related to them would be a pain.”
“H-hah...”

lines.japanese: いろいろとリアクションに困る冗談だ。
lines.english: That was a joke I had no idea how to react to.

lines.japanese: 「で、なにこれ？　こんな億行きそうな量のネタ、どっからパクってきたの？」
lines.english: “So what is this? Where’d you steal all that product? That could be worth a hundred million yen.”

lines.japanese: 「俺じゃねえよ。俺がギったわけじゃねえけど……まあ、ちょっと知り合いのチンピラが巻きこまれてて」
lines.english: “I didn't. I wasn't the one who swiped it, but... this low-level punk I know got mixed up in it.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ～。虎島興業の大口の売りモンが消えたって、街中のヤーさんがピリってるけど、そゆことね」
lines.english: “Ohhh. The yakuza all over town are on edge because Torashima Enterprises lost a major shipment. So that's what this is.”

lines.japanese: 「知ってんのかよ」
lines.english: “You knew?”

lines.japanese: 「俺ンとこにも連絡きたもん、ガキ共に怪しい動きがあったらすぐ教えろって。シカトしたけど」
lines.english: “They contacted me too. Told me to report any suspicious moves by the local punks immediately. I ignored them.”

lines.japanese: だが聞いているなら話は早い。
lines.english: If he already knew, that made this quicker.

lines.japanese: 「おまえ、いまでもそっち方面とのパイプあるんだな」
lines.english: “So you still have connections on that side.”

lines.japanese: 「こっちとしちゃ、もうべつに用ないから切りたいんだけど、なかなか向こうさんは忘れてくれなくてねえ」
lines.english: “I'd love to cut them off, since I don't need them anymore. They aren't so willing to forget me.”

lines.japanese: 「頼む。柳木原にいまエージってチンピラを監視してる組があるはずだから、ちょっとクチを利いてほしい」
lines.english: “Please. There should be a group in Yanagihara watching a punk called Eiji. I need you to put in a word.”

lines.japanese: 「どーだろ。向こうからすりゃ俺らなんか所詮ガキだし、ショージキ連中には無闇に貸し作りたくないんだよねえ」
lines.english: “I don't know. To them, we're just kids, and honestly, I don't wanna owe those people favors for no reason.”

lines.japanese: 「あァ、まあ……それはそうだろうけど……」
lines.english: “Yeah. I mean... I get that...”

lines.japanese: 想像はつく。カタギ相手とはいえ、あの手の人種と話しあって「許してあげてください」「いいですよ分かりました」で済むわけがない。
lines.english: I could imagine. Even with a civilian on the other side, a talk with people like that wouldn't end at ‘Please forgive him.’ ‘Sure, we understand.’

lines.japanese: 「分かるけど、そこをなんとか」
lines.english: “I understand, but please. Find a way.”

lines.japanese: 俺は素直に頭を下げた。
lines.english: I bowed my head in earnest.

lines.japanese: 「おまえが連中に貸しを作る分、俺もおまえに貸しイチってことにしてほしい。俺に出来ることなら何でもする」
lines.english: “Whatever favor you owe them, call it one favor I owe you. If it's something I can do, I'll do anything.”

lines.japanese: 「へぇー……」
やつは興味深そうに笑った。
lines.english: He smiled with interest.

lines.japanese: 「成田隼人がそこまで言うんだ。そんなに大事なやつなの、そのエージとかってのは」
lines.english: “Hayato Narita goes that far, huh? Is this Eiji guy really that important to you?”

lines.japanese: 「ぶっちゃけそんなでもねえ。シッタカ決めんのが最良な策だとも思う」
lines.english: “Honestly? Not especially. Playing dumb is probably the smartest thing I could do.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ放っとけば？　そういう馬鹿は、どうせまた同じ馬鹿を繰りかえすよ」
lines.english: “Then leave him alone. An idiot like that will only do the same stupid thing again.”

lines.japanese: 「かもしんねえ。でも、なんつーか、やつのことはこの際どうでもいいんだ」
lines.english: “Maybe. But... I don't know. At this point, it isn't really about him.”

lines.japanese: 「むしろ俺のキモチの問題なんだ。ここでやつを見捨てるのは、俺の正義に反する」
lines.english: “It's about how I'd feel. Abandoning him here would violate my sense of justice.”

lines.japanese: 「ふぅーん……」
lines.english: “Hmmm...”

lines.japanese: 鳳はしばらく長身から俺を見下ろしていた。
lines.english: Kakeru looked down at me from his full height for a while.

lines.japanese: 事態を検討していたのかもしれないし、単にお人よしな馬鹿を眺めて面白がっていただけかもしれない。
lines.english: Maybe he was considering the situation. Or maybe he was simply amused by the softhearted idiot in front of him.

lines.japanese: 「じゃ、お望みどおり、貸しイチってことで」
lines.english: “Fine. One favor, like you wanted.”

lines.japanese: しばらくしてやつは言った。そして俺の手からバッグを奪う。
lines.english: After a while, he spoke and snatched the bag from my hand.

lines.japanese: 「確約はできないけど、とりあえず心当たりに手ぇ回してみるよ」
lines.english: “I can't promise anything, but I'll start reaching out to the right people.”

lines.japanese: ケータイを操作しながら、鳳はガレージへ戻っていった。
lines.english: Working his phone, Kakeru went back into the garage.

lines.japanese: 今日はやたら貸しを作る日だ。
lines.english: I was racking up a lot of debts today.
